Internet Archive
Type of siteDigital library

The Internet Archive is an American non-profit organization founded in 1996 by Brewster Kahle.[1] It runs a digital library of websites, books, audio recordings, videos, images and software, with the stated mission of providing "universal access to all knowledge".

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Wayback Machine

History[edit]

Kahle founded the archive in May 1996, around the same time that he began the for-profit web crawling company Alexa Internet.

Early years[edit]

By late 1999 the organization expanded its collections beyond the web archive, beginning with the Prelinger Archives.

Wayback Machine[edit]

The Wayback Machine is a digital archive of the World Wide Web.

  • Launched to the public in 2001
  • Uses Heritrix crawlers
